target.statement: Average Gmean of 79.5 for OC-SVM+GRKneg variant 7 with 5 negative samples (averaged over all 14 one-class tasks)
target.table_ref: Table III, row 'Aver.', column 'variant 7' under '5 negative samples'
target.dataset: UCI datasets (Iris, Seeds, Ionosphere, Sonar, Qualitative Bankruptcy, Somerville Happiness) - 14 one-class tasks

compute.basis: Small UCI datasets (max 351 samples, 60 dims) with LIBSVM; but the code is Matlab R2017b, so an agent must reimplement GRKneg + OC-SVM/SVM in Python and rerun 14 tasks x 5 negative-sample settings x 5 splits x 5-fold CV hyperparameter search.

blockers: Reference implementation is Matlab (R2017b) + LIBSVM, not Python; agent must reimplement Algorithm 1 and the full CV protocol
Exact random seeds for negative-sample selection and train/test splits are not specified, so exact reproduction of 79.5 is unlikely (only approximate)
title: Generalized Reference Kernel With Negative Samples For Support Vector One-class Classification
